title: Lifecycle-Governed Retrieval and EvoMem-Enterprise Artifact
description: Reference implementation, generated benchmark worlds (EvoMem-Enterprise), validation-only label checkers, conformance and mutation tests, a standalone composed comparator, and raw evaluation outputs accompanying the lifecycle-governed retrieval manuscript. The archive reproduces every reported accuracy metric from a clean extraction; wall-clock latency fields are machine-dependent. Released as a design-and-pilot artifact, not a production-safety validation.
